biotools.summary: RNACOREX is a Python package for building Bayesian Network-based classification models using miRNA-mRNA post-transcriptional networks. It utilizes curated interaction databases and conditional mutual information to identify interactions and model them using Conditional Linear Gaussian Classifiers (CLGs).
